title: Mill Ave at Night
summary: A one-minute night drive along Mill Ave in Tempe, Arizona, filmed to show that the crash site looked much brighter than Uber's released dashcam video suggested. It was made in response to the fatal 2018 Uber self-driving crash.
why: Used as evidence that Uber's dashcam footage misrepresented how well lit the road was.

quote.text: there's been a couple people who've driven through the same area at night and it is well lit.
